selection: Lowest pooled rolling-validation MAE, including mean/median/persistence references; no benchmark tuning
features: Rain/temp departures from training-only seasonal means, lag2-minus-lag3 pressure/humidity, >=1mm rainy-day count, longest <1mm dry run within source period, NAO times seasonal sine/cosine, plus original inputs
training_only: Seasonal feature normals fitted on observed periods ending by each fold cutoff; target mean/median only fitted target labels
residual: Boosting target minus training calendar-month mean; add mean back and floor at zero
issue_timing: Identical original monthly/weekly delayed-input cutoffs; NOAA index assumptions inherited from extended experiment
caveat: Retrospective revised observations; 2024–2025 already examined, not a blind test. More candidates increase selection uncertainty.
